name: savvy-progress
description: A progress band above the prompt and the Agents pane: each subagent gets a crab and a card with its status, progress, cost and time, a timeline and a quiet-agent warning. Progress comes only from what was observed.

language.title: Panel language
language.description: auto (default) follows MODZ_LANG, then Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale, else English; or tr, en, ru
